mapper.select: /** getInstallYn **/ SELECT IFNULL(install_yn, 'N') as install_yn FROM device_map WHERE device_id = (SELECT id FROM device WHERE serial = #{serial} AND linked_yn = 'Y')

/* getCleanStartTime */ SELECT MIN(create_date) FROM history_clean_status hcs WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 'x' FROM device dev WHERE serial = #{serial} AND linked_yn = 'Y' AND hcs.device_id = dev.id) AND status = 'start' GROUP BY hcs.control_id ORDER BY MAX(hcs.id) DESC LIMIT 1

/** getDeviceConfig **/ SELECT IFNULL(NULLIF(dc.home_lock_yn, ''), 'N') AS homeLockYn , IFNULL(NULLIF(dc.privacy_mode_yn, ''), 'N') AS privacyLockYn , IFNULL(NULLIF(dc.night_mode_yn, ''), 'N') AS nightModeYn , IFNULL(NULLIF(dc.auto_call_yn, ''), 'N') AS autoCallYn , IFNULL(NULLIF(dc.setting_yn, ''), 'N') AS settingYn FROM device_config dc, device dev WHERE dc.serial = dev.serial AND dev.linked_yn = 'Y' AND dev.serial = #{serial}
/** getChargeState **/ SELECT so.charge_state FROM statistics_operation so JOIN device d ON d.id = so.device_id WHERE d.serial = #{serial} AND d.linked_yn = 'Y'

/** getChargingYn **/ SELECT CASE WHEN d.device_type = 'ABT' THEN IFNULL(so.is_charging, 'N') WHEN d.device_type = 'AQM_WLS' AND so.charge_state IN ('Charging', 'Charged') THEN 'Y' WHEN d.device_type = 'AQM' AND so.create_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 2 MINUTE) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END FROM statistics_operation so JOIN device d ON d.id = so.device_id WHERE d.serial = #{serial} AND d.linked_yn = 'Y'
